notes: Evaluated scroll transitions: 2 of 104 internal transitions (t32, t43); the other 102 (97 touch, 5 key) land on a different view and are recorded N/A — every screen they reach is judged in its own right as a screen, so for most screens Phase 1 is the whole audit. contains_selected_view appears in the capture (Library, Projects, gallery tabs); the side-menu section list and the Go/Plus switcher declare none, and their active states were read off the pixels and the live app. Structural same-view candidates (20): spot-checked t64 on the device (chip tap — user stays on New Project and the title persists, so nothing to promote); the 7 "@Create image" / "Good response" chat candidates join states that both lack an identifier, so there is nothing to lose — not promoted, not device-checked ("Good response" would send feedback). Candidates promoted: 0. Capture divergences: the home "Start a voice chat" row is gone (s2 unreachable); Library tabs now read Suggested/Favorites/Folders/Images; the Trending gallery content differs and photo templates open a dialog instead of the s11 sheet; a "Homework" project now exists. Feedback for location-graph-detector: t32 and t43 are not genuine same-view scrolls as recorded (the drawing canvas turns swipes into strokes; swipe-down on the image viewer dismisses it); the image gallery's "Images" title and tab row scroll away with the grid and return only at the top, and the Library tab row scrolls away under a pinned title — no scroll edge for either screen is in the capture, so neither loss could be verdicted. Screens whose only header region is the app's own name: s9, s44 (the "ChatGPT" wordmark in the side menu). Every in-app screen in the manifest was confirmed as this app's own surface; none excluded. Persona sessions: all four personas (Amy, Gopal, Kwame, Yuki) ran in parallel, one device each, shown the same 44 screens and the 2 scroll pairs. Every persona reversed t32 after trying the swipe live. t43 was flagged by all four but my verdict on it is N/A (no identifier to lose), not a pass, so it is outside Phase 7 and is not classified; Amy, Gopal and Kwame hold it softened, Yuki reversed it.
